# Sonar Create Project Action

This action creates a new project in SonarQube with the specified key and name.

## Inputs

| Name             | Description                             | Required | Default |
|------------------|-----------------------------------------|----------|---------|
| `sonar_host_url` | The URL of the SonarQube server.        | true     |         |
| `sonar_token`    | The authentication token for SonarQube. | true     |         |
| `project_key`    | The unique key for the new project.     | true     |         |
| `project_name`   | The name of the new project.            | true     |         |
| `project_key`    | The unique key for the new project.     | true     |         |
